news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics (PRCT) Stock May Be Fully Priced On Cash Flow Hopes
news.summary: A valuation note argues that after the late-October rebound the share price may already reflect expectations of future cash-flow improvement. It is a counterweight to bullish takes ahead of the November 4 Q3 report, where cash burn and the path to profitability will be scrutinized.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics: Compelling Bet On Aquablation's Growth
news.summary: A bullish Seeking Alpha piece argues Aquablation adoption and procedure growth make PROCEPT a compelling long at depressed valuations ahead of Q3 results.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Shares Climb 7.6%
news.summary: PRCT shares rose about 7.6% in one session, extending a late-October rebound from around $18-19 with no new company announcement; Wall Street consensus remains Hold.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Initiates PROCEPT BioRobotics With Buy Rating, $25 Price Target
news.summary: Piper Sandler started coverage of PRCT with a Buy rating and a $25 price target, adding a bullish voice as the stock tried to recover from its lows. The initiation helped fuel the mid-to-late October rebound.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4, 2026
news.summary: PROCEPT will release Q3 2026 results after market close on November 4, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. Investors will look for progress against the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guidance.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Upgraded at Barclays
news.summary: Barclays upgraded its rating on PRCT, one of several more constructive analyst moves in October following the stock's steep decline to multi-year lows.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Extends CIBC Term Loan Maturity to Oct 2028 Under Third Amendment
news.summary: PROCEPT amended its CIBC credit agreement, extending the term loan maturity to October 2028. The extension pushes out debt repayment and adds balance-sheet flexibility while the company works toward profitability.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Officially announced for November 4 after market close (call 4:30 p.m. ET). Key test for U.S. HYDROS system placements and procedure growth (Q2: 13,100+ U.S. procedures, +21%) against the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guide, plus gross-margin trajectory and cash burn.

pulse: PROCEPT shares rebounded to around $19-20 in the second half of October, helped by a Barclays upgrade and a Piper Sandler Buy initiation ($25 target), but remain far below their 52-week high near $67 with Wall Street consensus at Hold. Fundamentals last showed Q2 revenue +19% to $94.5M at 66% gross margin with $390-410M full-year guidance reiterated, and the CIBC term loan was extended to 2028. The November 4 Q3 report is the next major catalyst, where system placements, procedure growth and cash burn will decide whether the rebound holds.
